name: lmd
description: Autopilot pipeline (scouter → code-planner ⇄ plan-reviewer → developer ⇄ tester → reviewer ⇄ developer → committer) that drives a single task from intake to commit. All agent-to-agent context flows through files under `.lmd/autopilot/`; the main agent holds only short status payloads. Backed by 'brain', a Postgres graph + task store shared across sessions.

database_uri.title: Brain database URI
database_uri.description: Postgres connection string for the brain database. Format: postgresql://ai_agent:<pwd>@<host>:5432/<db_name>. Use a dedicated DB per project.

statement_timeout_ms.title: Brain statement timeout (ms)
statement_timeout_ms.description: Per-query timeout for the brain MCP server.

max_rows.title: Brain max rows per query
max_rows.description: Hard cap on rows returned by the `query` tool.
